items.comment: The author's wording correctly restores the conditional denominator, treatment of withheld limits, confidence requirement and pooled rule. It does not claim coverage among delivered limits. See supplement.md:137–151, qualify.py:215–225 and validate.py:133–156.

items.comment: “Any range” correctly makes δ the probability of joint containment failure. With all permitted cutoff-inclusion states searched, containing every true age also admits the true inclusion state (supplement.md:475–485).
